summary.intent: Execute plan 69-17 (gated write-plane tree materialization) as part of CipherBox phase 69, adding a `list_folder_owned` API to recover per-node write keys through the existing anti-rollback gate, while preserving workspace-green after every merge.
summary.outcome: Plan 69-17 was implemented in an isolated worktree, verified green (132 sdk tests, 8 new, workspace `cargo check` clean, fuse crate untouched), and merged into the base branch at `8e05c9db1`; execution sequence for the remaining phase 69 plans (69-18, 69-09, 69-10, 69-13) was recorded for follow-up.

repo: cipher-box phase 69 write-plane work must go through a single shared anti-rollback gate (SC#6) — new entrypoints call into it rather than adding new resolver functions.
D-07 dual-keyed parent/child pairing must be strictly by `published.id == WriteChildRef.child_id`.
`resolve_published_node` in crates/sdk/src/lib.rs must remain `pub(crate)`; only the new `list_folder_owned` entrypoint is `pub`.
D-09 terminal-owner invariant requires borrowed parent keys are never zeroed — verified via byte-unchanged tests on the caller's key buffer.
Workspace-green-after-every-merge invariant drives phase 69's plans to be merged serially rather than in parallel worktrees.

code.finding: `list_folder_owned` is the sole new `pub` entrypoint added by plan 69-17.

Houses `resolve_owned_child` and `list_folder_owned`, which recover per-node `{read_key, write_key, ipns_private_key}` for an existing tree through the shared gate; all 69-17 code changes confined to this file plus lib.rs.

workflow: Running `rustfmt` on a lib.rs that has `mod` declarations reformats the entire crate as a side effect, not just the touched file — check `git diff --stat` before committing and `git checkout --` any out-of-scope reformatted files.
Before merging a worktree-executed plan, verify fork base and scope (`git diff --stat` should show only the files the plan was meant to touch) before running the merge + post-merge cargo gate.
After merging, immediately update tracking and prune the now-stale worktree to avoid clutter.

friction: rustfmt's mod-following behavior silently reformatted 7 unrelated files in crates/sdk when only two import lines needed touching, requiring a manual revert before commit.
